_comment: GW-ARCH-001 sections 5.3, 6.2, 9.2. Tripo normalizes every generated asset into a ~1 m bounding cube, so authored scale is meaningless. This profile restores real-world scale. Equipment dimensions follow NADAC Equipment Specifications (2013-01-15); agility gear is sized relative to dog shoulder height, so the pet is the reference and everything else derives from it.

referenceDog.rationale: Border collie / spaniel build. The model's 1.12 body-to-shoulder ratio already matches this class. NADAC jump class for a 0.50 m dog is 16-20 in (0.41-0.51 m).

endarch.glb.identified: Finish gantry — two uprights with a crossbeam.
endarch.glb.specCheck: Aperture height 1.60 m >= 1.5 m corridor minimum (section 9.2). Width 2.53 m >= 0.8 m.

startgate.glb.identified: Multi-lane racing starting stalls on wheels (~8 bays).
startgate.glb.specCheck: 1.20 m matches a greyhound starting box. Each of ~8 bays becomes ~0.36 m wide; a 0.50 m-shoulder dog occupies one bay. NOTE: a single-lane variant is preferable for solo play.

playgroundladder.glb.identified: A-frame contact obstacle — two ramps meeting at an apex.
playgroundladder.glb.specCheck: NADAC A-frame apex 4 ft 8 in (1.42 m) for 8 ft ramps. Ramp width 0.894 m is just under the 0.91-1.22 m spec; acceptable for a stylised obstacle. Footprint 2.64 m is steeper than the ~3.74 m regulation run.

toyball.glb.specCheck: Tennis-ball diameter, correct for a medium dog's mouth. 4,837 triangles is heavy for a sphere this size — decimate to LOD0 <= 800.

dog-obstacle-course.glb.identified: Composite: 4 weave poles + dog walk + A-frame baked into one mesh.
dog-obstacle-course.glb.specCheck: Scaled so the dog walk reaches NADAC's 46 in (1.17 m). BLOCKED for runtime use: section 4.1 requires course content be data-driven from individually placed catalog props. Must be split into WEAVE, DOG_WALK and A_FRAME before publication.

weavepoles.glb.identified: Six weave poles on T-bases. Fills the gap left by dog-obstacle-course.
weavepoles.glb.note: Driven by pole SPACING, not height: 6 poles = 5 gaps x 0.610 m (NADAC centre-to-centre) = 3.05 m run.
weavepoles.glb.specCheck: Resulting pole height 1.056 m sits inside NADAC's 1.041-1.219 m band, so spacing and height are simultaneously in spec.

woodenramp.glb.identified: Elevated platform on legs with an access ramp.
woodenramp.glb.specCheck: NADAC dog walk height 46-50 in (1.168-1.270 m). Run is ~2.07 m against a regulation 3.5-3.66 m plank; this is a compact stylised variant.

catscratch.glb.identified: Cat tree - scratching post, tiered platforms, hanging ball.
catscratch.glb.specCheck: Typical cat tree 0.8-1.5 m. NOTE: first CAT asset in the set. Species 'cat' is allowed by section 6.2 and is ADR-005 primary, but no cat MODEL exists yet.

toyball-930.glb.specCheck: Tennis-ball diameter. Supersedes toyball.glb. Still heavy for a 6.7 cm sphere at typical screen size; 800 tris would be ample.
